_comment: Centralized registry of your proprietary production tools. During an engagement these are STRICTLY READ-ONLY (Tier 0): never edit, patch, or commit to them in place. To use one, copy it into engagements/<name>/sandbox/<tool>/ and run/patch the isolated copy there. The enforcement hook (enforce_scope.py) blocks in-place mutation of any 'path' below; the copy-to-sandbox workflow stays allowed. See global/CLAUDE.md §2C. This is an EXAMPLE registry — replace the entries and paths with your own tools.
